base-packages.description: space-separated packages installed by default; override this list for minimal or specialized toolchains

packages.description: additional space-separated packages to install; use 'name#version' to pin a specific version (e.g. 'utop ocamlformat#0.28.0'). Installation fails if a package is unavailable

optional-packages.description: space-separated packages to install only when opam can solve them for the selected switch and platform; same 'name#version' pin syntax as 'packages' (e.g. 'melange')

repositories.description: comma-separated extra opam repositories to add before installing packages: 'name url' pairs (e.g. 'rocq-released https://rocq-prover.org/opam/released')

pin-packages.description: comma-separated packages to pin: use 'name#version' to pin a specific version, 'name url' or 'name version' to pin via opam pin add (e.g. 'pkg1#1.0.0,pkg2 https://repo.git#branch')
